name: list_tags
title: List tags
description: List the tags that exist in Zammad, the most used first, optionally only those whose name contains query. Call it when the user asks which tags there are or which fit. set_ticket_tags needs no list first: it matches the names it gets and names the closest tags for one that does not exist.

query.description: A part of the tag name, such as "bill".

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous result, for the next tags.

total.description: How many tags match, on every page.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as cursor, with the same query, for the next tags.
